answer: Audit a random 5% of identities each epoch with a fresh task costing 40 tokens of real compute, with a 300-token bond forfeited on failure. A farm of 200 clones faces about 10 audits per epoch, so 10 x 40 = 400 tokens of compute, plus 10 x 300 = 3,000 at risk if they copy answers. Like an oasis amid umber dunes, honest work is rare; each pulse of audits drains fakes.
